main_text.l: isti duellatores, ut qui hanc le-
eos bene affecti simus, ac ma-lum

page.notes: Right margin: "Rom. 13." beside the line with "gladium"; "v.1.2.3.4." beside "non secun-" with "4." on the following line. Small stray marks in the right margin (a dot beside "gladium" and near "concredidit") are not text and are omitted. The word "concessam" has a doubtful ligature at "ss" and is marked [?]. "prorectori" is doubtful in the scan and marked [?]. The catchword "lum" completes "ma-" at the line end. Printed "justitiæ" and "ministros" are given with plain s and u/v/i/j normalised. Printed "suâ" and "expediendâ" are kept as printed, the latter with a doubtful final vowel; the printed text ends "expedienda," and is copied as printed with the comma.
